refreshToken.description:
When `true`, requests a proactive token refresh before returning.

In managed auth mode this triggers the normal refresh-token flow. In external auth mode this flag is ignored. Clients should refresh tokens themselves and call `account/login/start` with `chatgptAuthTokens`.

reloadAuth.description:
When `true`, reloads the auth storage snapshot before reading the current account details.

This is intended for clients that update persistent auth outside the app-server process. Externally managed account pools should prefer `account/login/start` with `chatgptAuthTokens` for normal account switches.
